page_title: RSO 3-0 BIL | Real Sociedad v Athletic Bilbao 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Calf Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
88' The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
86' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
82' Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) forces a pass into the box, but Alex Remiro is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
81' Mikel Merino comes off the pitch to be replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
81' Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
80' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
78' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
77' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Gil Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Dani Vivian is replaced by Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao).
75' Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ander Herrera leaves the pitch and Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
71' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Iker Muniain will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
68' The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
66' 3 - 0 Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is released by Martin Zubimendi, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
64' Nico Williams will be replaced by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
62' Robin Le Normand goes off the pitch and Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) comes on.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ander Barrenetxea walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
61' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Umar Sadiq and he is replaced by Andre Silva (Real Sociedad).
58' Ath Bilbao enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
54' The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.

54' Alex Remiro was forced into action to thwart Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
52' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' 2 - 0 Goal! Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:0.
46' Today's match ends for Gorka Guruzeta who will be replaced by Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Jesus Gil Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

42' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) produces an accurate shot from the free kick. His promising effort flies towards the middle of the goal, is blocked by Unai Simon, who makes a fine save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
42' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) will take the free kick.
42' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
40' The resulting corner, taken by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), comes to nothing.
40' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
38' The game is interrupted. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
36' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle and signals a foul after Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) brought his opponent down.
35' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

34' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:0.
30' Real Sociedad are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
29' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
25' Kieran Tierney is being substituted because of an injury. Imanol Alguacil sends Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) on the pitch.
24' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
23' Corner kick. Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) is ready to send the ball into the box.
22' The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
19' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad win a corner kick.

19' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
18' Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
17' Neat passing move from Real Sociedad in order to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
15' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Neat link-up play between Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) and Umar Sadiq, but Unai Simon reads the game well and the move breaks down.
11' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
9' The ball is cleared after Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
8' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
4' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
4' Ath Bilbao control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Ath Bilbao will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jesus Gil Manzano.
